**One More Quest 1.0** is here, just in time for the WoW Forever launch.

Everything the group has been testing over the last weeks is in: party stats, the distance arrow, quest sharing and the shared quest tracker, the "one more quest or bed time" vote, guidance to trainers, vendors and flight masters, alert cards, the dungeon group check, auction and vendor helpers, bets and titles. English and German clients are supported.

Install: unzip into the Interface/AddOns folder of your WoW Forever installation, then /reload in the game. With WowUp it updates by itself. /omq help lists the commands.
